text:
alex: Quick check — need to land PR #22011 (auth fallback) before the DB maintenance at 02:30 UTC. Small fix but CI is currently queued, can someone give quick eyes + rebase if needed?

maria: I can take a look in ~30m. If it slips past the window what's the user impact?

alex: Users might hit token refresh errors for a short period during the migration (no schema changes). It's a 3-line change in the auth handler. CI is stuck on mac integration jobs though.

jordan: Seeing the mac runners backlog. I'll try re-triggering the job and clear flaky: `/run-ci mac-integration`

sre-bot: CI queue update: mac runners backlog = 14, total queue = 27, est wait = 40-50m. Priority: normal.

tal: Heads-up — deploy-freeze is 02:00-03:00 UTC for the migration. We generally avoid any landings that overlap freeze unless emergency.

alex: Ah, missed the freeze window. The fix is urgent but not a full outage. Is a canary allowed? It's not behind a feature flag. :thinking_face:

maria: We could do a hotpatch via a dedicated canary branch and rollback tag, but that requires infra to approve an out-of-window deploy. @devops?

devops: We can run a one-off emergency deploy if you provide a justification and rollback plan. Prefer waiting until after the freeze. What exactly changes?

alex: Minimal: modify token refresh path to treat 503 as transient and retry once. Patch below:

```js
// auth/refresh.js
if (resp.status === 503) {
  // transient, retry once after jitter
  await sleep(300 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 200));
  resp = await fetchRefresh();
}
```

No DB migrations, no config flips.

jordan: That's safe code-wise but risky during an infra blackout. If CI clears in 20-30m we can land before freeze starts at 02:00? Current estimates say likely not.

tal: If CI > 45m, do not attempt landing. We had issues last blackout where a retry caused unexpected rolling restarts.

alex: Understood. If we wait, what's the next safe window?

maria: Post-maintenance window we get an immediate 02:45-03:30 slot we can use for a canary. Otherwise tomorrow morning maintenance slot.

devops: If you insist on out-of-window: need a runbook (rollback tag + monitoring dashboard pinned + oncall person). Otherwise queue for post-maintenance deploy.

alex: OK — will hold PR, add runbook and a short smoke test, and ping again after maintenance. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

jordan: I'll keep an eye on the mac runner queue and re-trigger if it clears.

sre-bot: Noted. Will post CI queue update in 10m.

tal: Thanks — mark as "hold-for-maintenance" so release automation doesn't pick it up.

alex: Done, added label and short runbook in PR description. Will re-open thread after maintenance.
